descriptions.text:
The BA thesis is the report of an independent investigation concluding the BA Linguistics. Together with their supervisor, students choose a linguistic domain, a research question and draw up a working plan for their investigation. In the thesis, students introduce the academic problem under investigation, justify their research question, describe their approach, present their research, discuss the results and present their conclusion. The average length is 10,000 words (including footnotes, references, but excluding appendices). The regulations and procedures concerning the BA thesis can be found [here](https://www.student.universiteitleiden.nl/en/your-study-programme/thesis-and-papers/humanities/linguistics-ba?cf=humanities&cd=linguistics-ba#tab-2).

A number of seminar meetings is offered during the second semester. Participation in this thesis seminar is mandatory and part of the 10 EC of the BA thesis.

More information will be available on [Brightspace](https://brightspace.leidenuniv.nl).

### Assessment

The thesis is assessed by the supervisor and a second reader, along dimensions 'Knowledge and insight'; 'Application of knowledge and insight'; 'Reaching conclusions'; 'Communication' (including writing skills, structure); and 'Learning skills' (including independence, planning, and handling of feedback).

Attendance and active participation in the thesis seminar are required.

### Submission

The final version of the BA thesis needs to be submitted by e-mail to your supervisor and second reader in both \*.doc and \*.pdf format with BAthesis@hum.leidenuniv.nl in CC.

**Deadlines:**
15 January: submitting thesis proposal (see top; admission requirements)
15 June: handing in final thesis
23 August: resit if necessary

**In case of writing in semester 1:**
15 September: submitting thesis proposal (see top; admission requirements)
17 December: handing in final thesis
30 January: resit if necessary

Enrolment through MyStudyMap (button in upper right corner) is mandatory. General information about course and exam enrolment is available on the website https://www.student.universiteitleiden.nl/en/your-study-programme/courses-and-exams/enrolment/leiden-university

The thesis seminar supports the writing process of student working on their BA thesis. The seminar mainly concerns form, layout, implementation and presentation of the thesis. The thesis is written under the supervision of a thesis supervisor, with whom all relevant agreements are made about the content and planning of the thesis.

This thesis seminar is for (third-year) students who are working on their BA Linguistics thesis (track Descriptive Linguistics).

After confirmation from their supervisor, students are required to submit their thesis proposal to the Board of Examiners with this [online form](https://www.formdesk.com/universiteitleiden/BA_Taalwetenschap_scriptieform). For the deadlines see below.

For substantive questions, contact the lecturer(s) (listed in the right information bar).  For questions about enrolment, admission, etc., contact the Education Administration Office: osz-oa-reuvensplaats@hum.leidenuniv.nl
The timetables are available through My Timetable (see the button in the upper right corner).
If the final version is not sufficient, the student can hand in a resit on 23 August / 30 January at the latest.

descriptions.value: The ability to continue performing effectively in changing and challenging circumstances; to cope with setbacks and recover from them.
Het vermogen om effectief te blijven functioneren in veranderende, uitdagende omstandigheden. Om kunnen gaan met en herstellen van tegenslag.
Achieving a result by effectively and systematically utilising and overseeing activities, time and resources.
Een resultaat bereiken door het effectief en planmatig inzetten en overzien van activiteiten, tijd en middelen.
Setting out ideas and information clearly in writing, taking account of the relevant target group and in such a way that the message is received and understood.
Ideeën en informatie helder op schrift stellen, rekening houdend met de doelgroep, en zodanig dat de boodschap overkomt en wordt begrepen.
Self-directing own process of absorbing and applying new knowledge and information.
Zelf sturing geven aan het eigen proces van nieuwe kennis en informatie opnemen en toepassen.
